title: Stay A Little
style: Indie-pop / it-pop, young female lead vocal, buoyant mid-tempo groove with crisp handclaps and tight live drums, rounded bass, bright jangly electric guitar and small piano accents. Begin with a close, conversational verse over sparse guitar; open into a catchy, layered chorus with light harmonies, then pull back for a reflective bridge before a final fuller chorus. Clean, warm, polished mix with an intimate vocal up front and a breezy coastal feel.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We came in under a dry, bright sky
The desert held the heat all afternoon
The pool ran blue into the Caribbean
I left my clothes beside the room

[Pre-Chorus]
You watched me pass in a sarong
Then looked away like nothing changed
The house was wide, the table set
And summer lingered in the air

[Chorus]
Stay a little, let the evening turn
Let the warm water keep its secret
We can take the long way back
Past the palms and the open sea
Stay a little, while the house is quiet
While the day is still ours to keep

[Verse 2]
At dawn we walked the public shoreline
Jairo carried what we couldn’t hold
A few strangers crossed the sand between us
Then the blue went on beyond the road

[Pre-Chorus]
By lunch the cranes were drawing outlines
Where the port would meet the open sea
Susana spoke of a flat nearby
Hope and doubt in the same breath

[Chorus]
Stay a little, let the evening turn
Let the warm water keep its secret
We can take the long way back
Past the palms and the open sea
Stay a little, while the house is quiet
While the day is still ours to keep

[Bridge]
The airstrip brought the family home
A fuller table, games until late
The rooms that felt so empty yesterday
Now hold a little more of everyone

[Final Chorus]
Stay a little, let the evening turn
Let the warm water keep its secret
We can take the long way back
Past the palms and the open sea
Stay a little, while the house is quiet
I might still slip away to the cabin
But tonight there’s room for me

[Outro]
The pool runs blue into the sea
The house is warm, the night is wide
